model.title: Bay Area Ridge National Scenic Trail Feasibility Study Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Adam Schiff (D-CA)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Secretary of the Interior to study whether the Bay Area Ridge could be designated as a national scenic trail, which would recognize its significance and potentially provide it with greater protection and support for maintenance and public access.
